description_en: Obtains a token for a group enterprise. This token serves as an authorization credential for calling APIs to retrieve data of subsidiary enterprises within the group
description_zh: 集团企业通过本接口获取 token，调用接口获取集团内子企业数据时，需要使用该 token 作为授权凭证
name: GroupCorpToken

parameters.help_en: The enterprise agent ID, which is used to establish a binding relationship between the enterprise and the application. For more information about how to obtain the ID, see Authorized enterprises (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667765)
parameters.help_zh: 企业代理 ID，用于建立企业与应用的绑定关系，获取方式请参见：可调用企业 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667765)
parameters.name: corp_id

parameters.help_en:
The subsidiary enterprise ID.
View permissions: Only enterprise administrators have the permission to view this ID.
View path: An enterprise administrator logs on to the Enterprise Management Console (https://admin.alibtrip.com/home/BtripIndex?s=api#/home) > Primary and sub-account management > Account management > Sub-account management > Company ID.
Image (https://intranetproxy.alipay.com/skylark/lark/0/2024/png/298807/1710403874851-5fb613cb-ced8-4b99-9151-486df29ba6c6.png)
parameters.help_zh:
子企业 ID。
查看权限： 仅企业管理员有查看权限。
查看路径： 企业管理员登录企业管理后台 (https://admin.alibtrip.com/home/BtripIndex?s=api#/home) > 主子账户管理 > 账户管理 > 子账户管理 > 公司 ID。
图片 (https://intranetproxy.alipay.com/skylark/lark/0/2024/png/298807/1710403874851-5fb613cb-ced8-4b99-9151-486df29ba6c6.png)
parameters.name: sub_corp_id

parameters.help_en: The API call secret of the application. For more information about how to obtain the secret, see Application basic information - Application credentials (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667763)
parameters.help_zh: 应用的 API 接口调用密钥，获取方式，请参见：应用基础信息-应用凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=4667763)
parameters.name: app_secret

parameters.help_en: The application credential, which is one of the header parameters in HTTP requests. Deprecated. Use the `app_secret` field instead
parameters.help_zh: 应用凭证，是 HTTP 方式中 header 参数之一。已作废，请使用 `app_secret`字段
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_access_token

expire.description_en: The validity period of the token. The default value is 2 hours (7,200,000 ms). To prevent the token from expiring, set the refresh interval to 5 minutes ≤ interval ≤ 2 hours. If you refresh the token within this interval, the token obtained from the previous request remains valid
expire.description_zh: token 的有效时长，初始值为 2 小时（7200000ms）。为防止 token 失效，建议刷新间隔控制为：5 分钟 ≤ 间隔 ≤ 2 小时。在此间隔内刷新，上一次请求获取的 token 仍然有效

start.description_en: The time when the token takes effect

token.description_en: The access credential of the group enterprise, which is the GroupCropToken

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, which is typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
